Observation: Great aesthetic interiors and lighting for Instagram reels and pictures, but prices for coffee and pastry easily cross ₹400 per person.
Source: Google Maps Reviews (Parashy Cafe Thillai Nagar)
Marketing opportunity: Introduce a ₹149 'Student Pocket-Friendly' Cold Brew + Cookie combo with high aesthetic presentation.

Research question: What frustrates students trying to study or do project work in local cafes?
Observation: Tried doing a group project here. Seating is comfortable but only 2 plug points near corner tables and music volume was too loud for discussion.
Source: Google Maps Reviews (CakeBee Cafe Thillai Nagar)
Marketing opportunity: Promote dedicated 'Study & Work Zones' featuring power sockets at every booth, high-speed fiber Wi-Fi, and low lo-fi ambient beats.

Research question: How do students in campus/outskirt college zones (e.g. NIT Trichy / Thuvakudi) handle cafe cravings?
Observation: Campus area only has quick tea stalls or late-night dhabas. To get a real cafe experience or specialty iced coffee, we have to travel 18 km into the city.
Source: Student Community Reviews (NIT Trichy Campus Forums & Outskirts)
Marketing opportunity: Run targeted weekend campaigns highlighting Brew & Bites as the ultimate weekend hangout destination, offering student ID travel perks or hostel group delivery.

Research question: What beverage types are most in-demand during Trichy's hot afternoons?
Observation: Trichy heat is intense from 11 AM to 4 PM. Students crowd cafes specifically for heavy air-conditioning, chilled coolers, iced coffee, and a cool escape between classes.
Source: Google Local Guides Reviews (CCD Thillai Nagar & Cantonment)
Marketing opportunity: Launch 'Beat the Trichy Heat' afternoon campaign (12 PM - 4 PM): 20% student discount on iced lattes, cold brews, and mocktails.

Research question: What drives repeat visits among college students (age 18-24)?
Observation: Students frequent local spots mostly when there are loyalty perks or split-bill friendly platters. High-end cafes are only visited on birthdays or post-exam treats.
Source: Zomato & Google Reviews (Temple In Cafe & local hangouts)
Marketing opportunity: Implement a digital WhatsApp/phone stamp card (5th coffee free) and 'Bites Platter' designed for college friend groups to split easily under ₹120 each.

Research question: What are young working professionals (age 22-30) in Trichy looking for in evening cafes?
Observation: IT employees, bank officers, and competitive exam coaching students in Cantonment/Thillai Nagar need a relaxed space post-6 PM to unwind without loud family restaurant chaos.
Source: Google Maps Reviews (Cantonment & Thillai Nagar evening spots)
Marketing opportunity: Position 'Evening Unwind Hours' (6 PM - 9 PM) with acoustic playlists, single-origin filter roasts, and quiet reading/networking corners.
